newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil president "satisfied" with re-election vote.
newsitem.headline: Brazil president "satisfied" with re-election vote.

text.p: Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso was "satisfied" that the Senate voted in favor of a bill allowing his re-election, presidential spokesman Sergio Amaral said.
"The president was satisfied," Amaral told reporters.
Cardoso himself startled reporters by joking during a meeting with deputy Luis Eduardo Magalhaes that he was surprised by the vote.
"It's a surprise, isn't it, deputy?" Cardoso said, according to photographers who were present.

The Senate voted 62-14 in a second and final vote to approve the constitutional amendment, which allows him and other executive officers to stand for a second term for the first time since the republic was founded in 1889.
